name: Campingplatz Aichalehof
beschreibung: The Aichalehof campsite is located on the western shore of Staffelsee and offers direct access to the water. Uffing is a small village in the Alpine foothills, about 20 kilometres east of Garmisch-Partenkirchen. The site has pitches, sanitary buildings and an access area to the lake. Nearby are hiking trails, and the rail connection makes day trips into the surrounding area possible. The surroundings are rural, with meadows and forests.
